_comment: VersityGW with the POSIX backend stores keys as file paths: repeated slashes collapse ('a//b' becomes 'a/b', overwriting it) and control characters come back as U+FFFD. Verified 2026-10-20 with versitygw v1.9.0.
_replaceDropsUnsentHeaders: A copy onto itself with x-amz-metadata-directive REPLACE keeps Cache-Control / Content-Disposition / Content-Language that the request leaves out (user metadata is replaced). Verified 2026-10-21, v1.9.0.
_headReportsDeleteMarker: HEAD / GET on a deleted key answer a bare 404; only HEAD on the marker's own version id answers 405 with x-amz-delete-marker. A DELETE of a key that doesn't exist creates no marker. Verified 2026-10-21, v1.9.0.
